title: Rossi devices and ring superconductor experiments

tellings.quote: I built a handful of different uh devices that um uh had some interesting effects that seemed to substantiate what a lot of the theory that people like uh Dr. Puthoff, um uh Dr. Davis, and others um have discussed.

plain: Dave Rossi tells podcast host Jesse Michels that between about 2021 and 2024 he built a handful of devices, including experiments with rings of superconductor, a material that carries electricity with no resistance. He says they produced interesting effects that seemed to back up theories discussed by researchers Hal Puthoff, Eric Davis and others, which would matter because it would mean those unusual physics ideas work in practice.
